interpretation: The dominant 11032 hard-tail failure occurs before downstream basin selection: the true B endpoint's projections are usually absent from the retained per-view top-4 descriptor candidate sets. Consequently the pairwise rank-3 H_i cannot contain a target-near endpoint. This localizes the current Test-C RED primarily to descriptor candidate retrieval/truncation (with a minority of possible cross-view consistency cases), not to an oracle selector choosing the wrong member of an otherwise sufficient H_i.
